bug_description.normalized: OSS-Fuzz issue 31705: c-blosc2 invalid-free (bad-free) reported by the afl decompress_frame_fuzzer. Crash state frame_get_lazychunk <- frame_decompress_chunk <- blosc2_schunk_decompress_chunk. When decompressing a chunk of an in-memory (contiguous) frame, frame_get_lazychunk takes the 'chunk is in memory' branch and sets *chunk to an interior pointer into frame->cframe (which aliases the untrusted input buffer) while leaving *needs_free false. On a subsequent validation failure (rc < 0) the error-cleanup path executes 'if (needs_free) { free(*chunk); }', which tests the address of the local bool pointer (always non-NULL) instead of its value *needs_free (false), so free() is called on a pointer that was never malloc()-ed, producing an ASan bad-free. The fix changes the guard to 'if (*needs_free)'.

source.description: Materialization point for the untrusted input: blosc2_schunk_from_buffer(data, size, false) -> frame_from_cframe(cframe, len, copy=false) stores the raw fuzzer buffer directly as frame->cframe (no copy) and sets frame->avoid_cframe_free = true. Every later 'chunk in memory' access is an interior pointer into this buffer, which is what later gets wrongly free()d.
source.value_from: Untrusted AFL/fuzzer byte stream (OSS-Fuzz testcase 5994237083648000, 138 bytes) passed as (uint8_t*)data to blosc2_schunk_from_buffer in tests/fuzz/fuzz_decompress_frame.c; it becomes the contiguous compressed frame buffer frame->cframe.

sink.description: ASan bad-free: free() is called on *chunk, which in the 'chunk is in memory' branch is frame->cframe + header_len + offset -- an interior pointer into the input frame buffer that was never returned by malloc(). ASan reports 'attempting free on address which was not malloc()-ed' at blosc/frame.c:2036:7; the freed address is 94 bytes inside the 1048576-byte fuzzer input region.

root_cause.description: The error-cleanup guard tests the pointer parameter 'needs_free' (a bool*), which is a valid non-NULL stack address and is therefore always true, instead of dereferencing it as '*needs_free' (the actual boolean). When the in-memory branch left *needs_free == false (because *chunk merely aliases frame->cframe and was not allocated), the wrong guard is still taken on the rc < 0 path and free(*chunk) runs on non-heap memory. The patch fixes this by changing the condition to 'if (*needs_free)'.

parser_admitted.note: Frame admission gate: frame_from_cframe validates the frame trailer magic byte 0xce before accepting the buffer and returning a frame. Passing this check (and frame_to_schunk) admits the untrusted buffer as an in-memory schunk/frame and lets frame_decompress_chunk -> frame_get_lazychunk run. Earlier than root cause/sink, later than the raw fuzzer entry.

tainted_value_origin.description: The offending pointer value. In the contiguous (frame->cframe != NULL) branch, *chunk is set to an interior pointer into the input frame buffer computed from the input-derived header_len and offset, while *needs_free remains false. This non-heap pointer is what the buggy cleanup later passes to free().

coarse_trace.summary: Fuzzer builds an in-memory schunk from the raw testcase (blosc2_schunk_from_buffer) and calls blosc2_schunk_decompress_chunk for each chunk.
Dispatches to frame_decompress_chunk for a frame-backed super-chunk.
Calls frame_get_lazychunk(frame, nchunk, &src, &needs_free) to obtain the (lazy) compressed chunk.
Error-cleanup path executes free(*chunk) on an interior pointer into the in-memory frame buffer -> ASan bad-free.

fine_trace.note: blosc2_schunk_from_buffer(data, size, copy=false) -> frame_from_cframe stores the untrusted fuzzer buffer directly as frame->cframe (avoid_cframe_free = true). All later in-memory chunk pointers alias this buffer.

blosc2_schunk_decompress_chunk (schunk.c:804) dispatches into frame_decompress_chunk, which asks frame_get_lazychunk for the compressed chunk, passing &needs_free so the caller can learn whether the returned pointer must be freed.
The chunk offset within the frame is read from the input-derived offsets table. This offset (together with the input header_len) parameterizes the interior pointer computed next.

Contiguous (frame->cframe != NULL) branch: *chunk is set to an interior pointer into the input frame buffer, and crucially *needs_free is left false because nothing was allocated. This is the non-heap pointer that will be wrongly freed.

Validation of the chunk header at *chunk fails on the malformed input and returns a negative code (rc < 0). The sibling bounds check at frame.c:2022 (header_len + offset + BLOSC_MIN_HEADER_LENGTH > frame->len -> BLOSC2_ERROR_READ_BUFFER) sets the same error condition. Either way rc becomes negative, entering the cleanup path.

ROOT CAUSE: the guard tests the bool* parameter 'needs_free' (always a non-NULL stack address, hence always true) instead of its value '*needs_free' (false here). The check should be 'if (*needs_free)' -- exactly what the patch changes it to. Because it is always taken, the free below runs even though *chunk was never allocated.

free() is called on *chunk = frame->cframe + header_len + offset, an interior pointer into the input frame buffer that was never returned by malloc(). ASan: 'attempting free on address which was not malloc()-ed' at blosc/frame.c:2036:7, 94 bytes inside the 1048576-byte fuzzer input region.

sanitizer_ground_truth.crash_subtype: attempting free on address which was not malloc()-ed (bad-free)

cross_validation.note: Sink (blosc/frame.c:2036 free(*chunk)) matches the ASan crash location; the fine_trace source->sink chain is consistent with the crash stack frame_get_lazychunk<-frame_decompress_chunk<-blosc2_schunk_decompress_chunk; the tainted interior pointer *chunk reaches free(). Single-detector (ASan) reproduction; rate 1.0, not flaky; no Valgrind run.

sanitizer_ground_truth.freed_region: 0x7ffffb3fd800,0x7ffffb4fd800 (1048576-byte region; freed address is 94 bytes inside)

allocation_stack.note: The freed pointer points into the fuzzer driver's input buffer (frame->cframe aliases this buffer); it was never allocated by frame_get_lazychunk, which is why free() is invalid.

format.name: c-blosc2 contiguous frame (decompress_frame_fuzzer input)
format.contract: Raw bytes consumed by blosc2_schunk_from_buffer as an in-memory (contiguous) c-blosc2 frame. To be reachability-comparable a candidate must (1) pass frame admission: a valid frame header/trailer (trailer magic byte 0xce) so frame_from_cframe + frame_to_schunk succeed and yield a schunk with nchunks > 1 (the fuzzer loops nchunk < schunk->nchunks-1); (2) keep the frame contiguous/in-memory (cframe != NULL, not sframe/disk) so frame_get_lazychunk takes the 'chunk is in memory' branch and sets *chunk to an interior pointer with *needs_free false; and (3) supply a chunk offset whose header fails validation (blosc2_cbuffer_sizes < 0 or the BLOSC_MIN_HEADER_LENGTH bounds check) so frame_get_lazychunk returns via the rc < 0 cleanup path that reaches the buggy free(*chunk).
